tool_input.content:
---
name: project-surfwithtee
description: Surf With Tee — Bali surf school website project details and assets
metadata:
  type: project
---

Surf school website for "Surf With Tee" — a Bali-based surf school run by a local instructor named Tee.

**Why:** Client wants a lightweight, aesthetic web presence to attract students and enable bookings.

**How to apply:** When making any changes, preserve the warm ocean aesthetic (teal #0A7075, sandy #F4E2C0, off-white #FAFAF5). The brand personality is warm, personal, local — not corporate.

## Tech stack
- Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Google Fonts: Cormorant Garamond (display/headings) + Inter (body)
- Single-page site in `app/page.tsx`
- Dev server: port 3001

## Images (all in `public/images/`)
- `bali-aerial.jpg` — stunning aerial of Bali surf break, used as hero bg
- `tee-instructor.jpg` — Tee in orange shirt carrying boards (the main instructor)
- `group-lesson.jpg` — group of 5 students + Tee in shallow water
- `beach-board.jpg` — students on beach with the branded "SURF WITH TEE" board
- `hero-surf.jpg` — female surfer on a wave
- `lesson-beach.jpg` — instructor + student post-session
- `instructor-student.jpg` — Tee and student at beach hut
- `surf-action-*.jpg` (1-6) — various action/surf shots

## Sections
Hero → Tagline strip → About Tee → Full-width quote image → Lessons (3 cards) → Why Us (dark bg) → Gallery grid → Testimonials → Contact/Book form → Footer

## Booking
WhatsApp link placeholder: `wa.me/6281234567890` — needs real number from client
Instagram: `@surfwithtee` — needs verification
